solutions.title: Linear history scan
solutions.strategy: Keep every key history in insertion order and scan backward for the first visible timestamp.

timeComplexity.explanation: A get may inspect every version for that key.

solutions.title: Binary search history
solutions.strategy: Keep each key's timestamp history sorted by append order and binary-search the rightmost visible timestamp.

timeComplexity.explanation: A get performs one binary search over that key's m versions.
